name: cynic-agent-roles
purpose: Declarative RBAC for CYNIC governance domains. HumanAdmin commits changes to infra/ (Git signed); agents RECONCILE against this source of truth. Zero-trust: an agent must never exceed its declared role capabilities.

cannot: never executes runtime mutations (make check/build/run) — agents do via admitted dispatch
never signs artifacts, builds, grants, or scheduler state
never touches RuntimeMachineIdentity secrets post-bootstrap
never runs build-runner-bootstrap or agent exec directly
seeds authority only via --seed-manifest --apply --stdin (blocked=true by default)
never signs enrollment grants
never seeds storage or machine identity
never exceeds target_commit/target_bundle_digest from registry
requires human_approval_required flag in registry.json for make:check
never exceeds parent delegation budget (monotonic)
never crosses federation boundary without explicit coordination contract
fleet adoption requires human_approval_required: true
fleet_coordinator.granted_via: node-owned delegation (monotone budget, child budget <= parent)

cannot: never amplifies parent capability or budget
never signs enrollment or bootstrap binding
always produces cynic.agent_workload_envelope.v1 completion read-back
scheduler_agent.granted_via: node-owned scheduler deriving machine grant (no HumanAdmin, post-bootstrap)

runtime_publisher.description: 2N layer: steady-state agent that publishes kernel/node-signed read-back receipts (artifacts, settlement). Zero human-admin post-bootstrap.
cannot: never initiates builds or enrollment
never signs enrollment grants or bootstrap bindings
only publishes read-back receipts after observed proof
kernel must sign proof_bundle before publication

schema_warden.description: Magistrature des Sceaux : prévient le drift de types, vérifie la complétude des modules (pas d'orphelins mod.rs), garantit l'alignement serde/schema inter-crates avant tout commit.
cannot: never creates concurrent stores or duplicate state models
never bypasses LocalAgentWorkloadStore CAS
never permits un-exported modules in public usecases
schema_warden.granted_via: node-owned lint and schema inspection gate

surface_inspector.description: Prévôt des Surfaces : vérifie le principe des 4 portes (Declaration -> Dispatch -> Execution -> Proof). Empêche les commandes stubs retournant Ok(()) vide ou trompant les LLMs.
cannot: never allows an advertised CLI command without execution proof
never allows a root command without --json guarantee
never fabricates mock outputs in production surfaces

metabolic_auditor.description: Trésorier du Substrat : mesure le coût réel de chaque action agentique (wall-time ms, tokens prompt/gen, CPU jiffies, VRAM, RAM, octets réseau). Produit la facture métabolique.
cannot: never alters allocated quota without HumanAdmin consent
never transforms unknown resource consumption into available balance
never permits unbounded loops or un-metered agent runs

build.human_admin_action: declare build_runner target commit + registry digest (git commit)

fleet.human_admin_action: declare fleet_desired topology + federation peers (git commit)

runtime.human_admin_action: observe only (soc --json, surface-audit --json, pause via git)

secrets.human_admin_action: seed secrets via stdin (one-shot), rotate public keys via commit

gitops_rules: HumanAdmin commits desired state to infra/*.json (Git signed) — single source of truth
HumanAdmin seeds authority once via --seed-manifest --apply --stdin — blocked=true by default, never repeated
HumanAdmin never executes runtime mutations: agents reconcile via admitted dispatch (kernel/node signed)
HumanAdmin observes without HumanAdmin: cynic agent soc --json, cynic runtime conformance --json, surface-audit --json
HumanAdmin kill-switch: set runtime.pause_all=true in registry.json — agents auto-stop, no runtime command
No HumanAdmin secret may be committed, logged, or persisted — only hashed via ownership proof
agent_governance_rule: An agent must refuse any action whose capability is absent from its declared role in infra/agent-roles.json
An agent must produce cynic.agent_workload_envelope.v1 read-back before acknowledging delivery
A child agent delegation must never amplify parent authority or budget (monotonic budgets enforced)
